 What should a bare commit (e.g. `citydiff -range abc123`, or `"range": "HEAD"` in a tour) mean?

❯ 1. That commit's own change (Recommended)
     abc123 => abc123^..abc123; HEAD => HEAD^..HEAD. The diff is exactly what that one commit did. A root commit
     diffs against the empty tree.
  2. That commit up to HEAD
     abc123 => abc123..HEAD; HEAD => HEAD..HEAD (empty, so falls back to HEAD^..HEAD? or errors). The diff is
     everything since that commit.
  3. Treat 'HEAD' specially only
     Only HEAD means HEAD^..HEAD; any other bare hash is still an error requiring A..B.
  4. Type something.
